name: Raspberry-Chia Seed Pancakes with Bananas & Honey

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, chia seeds, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the flour mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup chia seeds
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs and milk in another medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in a large skillet over low heat. Once melted, pour butter into the bowl with the eggs, whisking quickly to combine. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Create a well in the center of the flour mixture. Add the egg mixture and whisk until batter is just combined.

Wash, dry, and add raspberries to the bowl with the batter. Using the back of a spoon, lightly crush the raspberries (breaking them into smaller pieces), then stir to incorporate them into the batter.
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart. Cook, flipping once, until pancakes are golden and cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice bananas.
To serve, divide pancakes between plates; top with sliced banana, then drizzle with honey. Enjoy!
